recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless this extension is intentionally brought back into the core build; future definition changes should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-38043 was an Applied/Persuasive PA issue requesting that the Patient importance extension receive an example binding to PatientImportance and guidance to consider Resource.meta.security/VIP security labels and Encounter.specialCourtesy.
initial_application: No current FHIR core commit explicitly applied FHIR-38043. Core removed source/patient/structuredefinition-extension-patient-importance.xml in dd468d4f17 during the R5 extension handoff. The issue was applied in HL7/fhir-extensions by 2a19708, corrected by dff3387 to use the ValueSet URL, and completed by a4081a3 with the description guidance.
additional_context: Current core source has no active fhir.ini profile entry or Patient StructureDefinition for patient-importance; searches find only source/oids.ini plus historical and terminology files. Zulip discussion and PA minutes support the guidance text now present in the Extension Pack definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source was changed because the build-scoped definition lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and is already corrected there.
